# Security Policy

## Supported Versions
Currently, Scrygent is in active development. Only the `main` branch is supported with security updates.

## Reporting a Vulnerability
If you discover a security vulnerability (e.g., a bypass in the hermetic execution boundary or a prompt injection vector), please do not open a public GitHub issue. 

Instead, please report it via [GitHub Private Security Advisories](https://github.com/mohamadmeri/scrygent/security/advisories/new) or email me directly at `[mohamad-meri@outlook.com]`.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide a timeline for the fix.
